annotations.title: AI email subject lines with scoring

description: AI email subject lines with scoring — Generates 3-15 email subject lines with preheaders in mixed styles (benefit, curiosity, question, specific number, personalized) for an email body or one-line description, then scores each 0-100 offline for mobile length, spam-trigger words, ALL-CAPS, repeated exclamation marks and fake RE:/FWD: prefixes, sorted best first. Optional: n (default 8), tone, audience. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. Black Friday: 30% off all annual plans until Monday
